narr: Two very slow-moving areas of thunderstorms crossed western Kentucky during the overnight hours into the early morning hours. These storms dumped up to 5 inches of rain in about 6 hours. Isolated pockets of flash flooding occurred with these excessive rain totals. The storms were associated with a weak cold front that extended from Lake Michigan south into the lower Ohio Valley.
ev: Six to eight inches of water was flowing across Highway 813 near Mortons Gap.

Numerous streets were closed in Central City, including South 2nd Street and Broad Street. A water rescue was conducted on Taylor Road. A car was submerged. At least three feet of water were inside a home. Homes on Pattontown Drive in Central City were evacuated. Flooding was reported on Highway 175 near the interchange with the West Kentucky Parkway near Graham. Two separate rainfall totals over 6 inches were measured in Central City. Totals of 6.02 and 6.39 inches were measured by separate personal weather stations in Central City between midnight and 7 AM.
